ranked.text: PostgreSQL password authentication failures for feature-service caused feature builds to fail and return 5xx during the incident window.
Feature-service 5xx errors were caused by internal feature build failures that generated error log lines, independent of database authentication failures.
A recent GitOps commit or rollout touching feature-service introduced a defect or misconfiguration that caused the 5xx errors.
CPU throttling of feature-service pods caused slow feature build execution and request timeouts, resulting in 5xx responses.
